title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.42100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Despite many high-profile successes in recent years, deep RL is known to be brittle. An emerging line of research attributes this brittleness to a loss of plasticity in neural networks. However, plasticity loss has so far been understudied in stochastic environments. We study this interplay systematically, training SAC agents on three DeepMind Control tasks augmented with controlled levels of observation and action noise. We find that plasticity-preserving methods increase learning robustness on the two harder tasks, with their advantage growing as observation noise increases, while combining resets with layer normalization underperforms resets alone at every observation noise level tested. translated_title: 迈向理解可塑性损失对随机环境中强化学习的影响
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（RL）是序列决策的强大框架。尽管近年来取得了许多引人瞩目的成功，但深度RL的脆弱性是众所周知的。新兴的一类研究将这种脆弱性归因于神经网络可塑性的丧失。然而，到目前为止，可塑性损失在随机环境中尚未得到充分研究。我们系统地研究了这种相互作用，在三个加入了可控水平的观测噪声和动作噪声的DeepMind Control任务上训练SAC智能体。我们发现，可塑性保持方法在两个较难的任务上提高了学习的鲁棒性，其优势随着观测噪声的增加而增长，而在所有测试的观测噪声水平下，将重置与层归一化相结合的表现均不如单独使用重置。此外，随机性可以加速较难环境中可塑性的丧失，而在较简单的设置中，噪声反而可以充当一种维持可塑性的正则化器。
tldr: 该论文系统研究了随机环境中可塑性损失对深度强化学习的影响，发现可塑性保持方法能提升学习的鲁棒性且其优势随观测噪声增大而增长，同时随机性在困难任务中会加速可塑性丧失，而在简单任务中却能起到维持可塑性的正则化作用。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies how plasticity loss affects deep RL in stochastic environments, showing that plasticity-preserving methods improve learning robustness with advantages growing as observation noise increases, and that stochasticity accelerates plasticity loss in harder tasks while acting as a regularizer that sustains plasticity in easier settings.
